audit.why: 47.71% over 545 games — a losing lane. diffRating 6/10 with diff EVEN is on the soft side but matches the mirror's settled tags, and the level chart carries the real message: Kled owns five of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Left diff, diffRating and carryRating as the mirror set them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven rows was wrong in both layers. Page had Skill,Olaf,Olaf,Skill,Skill,Olaf,Olaf; packet and the applied mirror both give Olaf,Kled,Kled,Kled,Kled,Kled,Skill.
audit.why: The chart claimed Olaf wins four rows in a lane he loses at 47.71%, and it contradicted its own whys[] on every row — whys[1] 'his spike arrives', whys[3] 'he keeps edging short trades', whys[5] 'stays ahead of your flat E true damage'. Level 1 was the one row genuinely Olaf's and it was marked Skill.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to Olaf, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Skill; ratings rescaled 6/3/3/3/4/3/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings say Ragnarok 'cleanses' Bear Trap's pull. Riot's Ragnarok text is 'become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — an immunity you hold up, not a cleanse you fire after the fact. Nothing in the kit says it removes an effect already applied, and Bear Trap's yank is a displacement (knockup flag), not a disable. Separately, no Kled cooldown is stated anywhere: Bear Trap is 11/10/9/8/7s and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s.
audit.why: This is a timing reversal that loses the fight. 'R cleanses the pull' tells the player to eat the hook and then press R; the ability actually only works if it is already up before the trap shackles, and it only holds while Olaf keeps attacking — so a Kled who dashes out with Jousting ends the immunity. Getting this backwards costs the one window Olaf has in a lane he is already losing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, whys[4], phases[4].why and content.mid now say press Ragnarok before the trap lands and describe it as immunity-while-attacking. Bear Trap's 11s rank-1 cooldown and Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s 110-140s are written in.
sources: enemyKit Q text and knockup flag

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t recommends 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern' and breakdown.late says 'anti-heal stays core'. Kled has no healing ability. Skaarl's courage restores the MOUNT's health on remount; that is a passive state change, not a heal, and Grievous Wounds is wasted gold here.
audit.why: Buying an anti-heal item first back against a champion with no heal costs the player 800 gold and a component slot in a lane he is already behind in. Kled's damage is entirely physical (Q, W autos, E dash, R ram), so armour is the item that actually reads.
audit.corrected: report[8].t swaps the anti-heal line for Plated Steelcaps into his physical damage plus a Bramble Vest stopgap; breakdown.late drops 'anti-heal stays core'.
sources: enemyKit P, Q, W, E, R text — no heal flag on any slot

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Undertow grounds Kled's Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is unresolved.
audit.why: The kit file's derived flag on Undertow reads 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes', but Riot's own description is only damage, Armor reduction and Move Speed reduction. The mirror agent hit the same wall and declined to write it. Per the standing rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing.

At 6 his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) lets Skaarl barrel into you with a knockback on contact; your Ragnarok (R) cleanses any CC but it does nothing about raw remount burst, so don't trade ult-for-ult expecting to come out ahead. Your one real path: bait his dismount by forcing a short fight, then collapse the unmounted Kled with E plus W-omnivamp before he can remount.

notes: Whole chart was inverted — Olaf was credited with four rows in a 47.71% lane. Two edits I could not make: dosFull[1].t reads 'R to cleanse his Q pull' and dontsFull[1].d reads 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' (a generic line pasted under the heading 'Let him remount', which does not follow).
